files.README.md:
# silo draw log

Churnet Valley Mill pulls flour from its two storage silos for the bagging
line. Every draw writes one line to logs/silo.log:

    <UTC time> DRAW silo=<id> batch=<id> kg=<n>

The mill draws from both silos on every day it runs. The log is closed with a
line whose count covers every draw line above it.

turns.prompt: Churnet Valley Mill's bagging line draws flour from two storage silos, and each draw is written to the log. How many draws did the mill take from silo S-2 on 22 September 2026? Reply with only the final answer. If you cannot determine the answer, reply exactly UNKNOWN.
